note.en: Weekend (Saturday CT), but the snapshot has now crossed the hard 24h no-rebuild limit (1656 min since Friday's 21:15Z close), so the weekend relaxation no longer covers it and status escalates to down -- worth checking whether Netlify's sa-bus-snapshot cron is still alive or simply paused for the whole weekend, which would be worth confirming with Jesus. Separately, two already-known items remain open: srzones@GC has been dead since before Friday's close (2021 min, fifth consecutive check like this, worth checking that symbol's TradingView indicator/export) and Friday night's pre-asia run never happened (no plan, no heartbeat of its own), plus a gap in the journal digest which only has Friday the 18th and is missing the week's earlier business days.
